label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Rohan, fair question da. Sneha, no no, let him ask. He and Divya gave me actual money, not “thoughts and prayers” on LinkedIn. I owe them a better answer than “difficult decisions” and a folded hands emoji.

Straight answer: your 3 lakh is still invested in FixKaro. The money is at risk. It’s not gone, but I genuinely cannot promise you’ll get it back. So I can’t honestly say “all safe macha”, and I’m not saying write it off either.

What happened: the bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct. Term sheet was basically ready, but basically ready is unfortunately not a currency accepted by payroll. The partner said “we love the energy” and then didn’t reply for 11 days. Apparently the energy was best enjoyed from a distance.

Last Friday we let go of 6 out of 14 people. Everyone got two months’ pay, and we’ve helped four of them get interviews already. Those are interviews, not jobs yet. Letting them go was the worst day of my life. These people put real work into this, and having to tell them we couldn’t keep them on was horrible. No funny version of that bit.

After the cuts, we have about five months of runway. That’s where we stand today.

The app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbers and electricians are growing, but AC servicing is bleeding money. So the plan is to shut AC servicing and focus on housing society tie-ups. Three societies in HSR have already signed pilots. I honestly think we have a real shot there. But pilots aren’t proof that this will work, and five months isn’t unlimited time to figure it out.

Your and Divya’s investment was on the same terms as everyone else in the 2025 friends round. You trusted me with real money. Being my friend doesn’t mean you have to politely avoid asking about it, especially while I’m posting like a defeated cricket captain. Ajay, irritatingly accurate review.

Let’s do a proper call this week, you, Divya and me. I’ll show you the numbers, what we’re spending, and what needs to happen over the next few months. You both should get to ask me directly, rather than you having to give Divya a second-hand explanation over dinner.

And before this group organises a candle march, I’m okay. Stressed, yes. Eating Maggi at the office at 11pm often enough that security uncle now asks “masala or plain”, also yes. Amma has already asked whether TCS is still hiring, so the family advisory board has submitted its recommendation.

I’m coming Saturday. Happy to talk, also very happy to discuss literally anything other than runway for a bit. Pranav is buying. That funding round I would like closed before we order.
